items.title: CPI, Cisco earnings, and more: What investors need to watch Wednesday
items.summary: Asking for a Trend Host, Josh Lipton previews what investors should watch on Wednesday, August 12, including the latest Consumer Price Index (CPI) report, which will offer a fresh look at inflation and the health of the consumer. Cisco (CSCO) reports fiscal fourth-quarter results, while Bloomin' Brands (BLMN) also reports earnings.

items.title: Does Cisco’s Expanded AI Infrastructure Orders and Employee Agents Change The Bull Case For Cisco Systems (CSCO)?
items.summary: Cisco Systems recently briefed investors and industry audiences on its AI and networking ambitions through conference presentations in Taipei and Santa Clara, while preparing to release its fiscal Q4 2026 results after the market close on August 12. At the same time, Cisco has begun rolling out personalized AI agents to its roughly 90,000 employees and raised its full-year AI infrastructure order outlook, underscoring how deeply AI is being woven into both its operations and revenue...

items.title: Fortinet Lifts 2026 Guidance on Firewall, SASE Demand: Buy the Stock?
items.summary: FTNT raises 2026 guidance as firewall refreshes and SASE adoption accelerate, and AI and silicon advances strengthen its growth outlook.

items.title: Stocks to Watch Wednesday: CoreWeave, Super Micro, Cisco
items.summary: ↗️ CoreWeave (CRWV): Shares jumped over 20% in morning trading after the cloud-computing company posted its fifth straight quarter of record revenue, fueled by sustained AI demand. ↗️ Super Micro Computer (SMCI): Shares rose above 15% at the open after the company reported a surging profit and sales nearly doubling in its fourth quarter.
